{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction
n_loyal = len(df_loyal)
converted_loyal = df_loyal['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print each number used in evidence
print(f"n_loyal = {n_loyal}")
print(f"converted_loyal = {converted_loyal}")
print(f"fraction_converted = {fraction_converted}")"}
